description: This file defines a REST controller in a Spring Boot application for managing Question entities, including endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting questions.

classes.name: QuestionController
classes.description: REST controller exposing CRUD endpoints for Question entities.

methods.name: getQuestions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a paginated list of questions.

methods.name: createQuestion
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new question.

methods.name: updateQuestion
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing question by ID.

methods.name: deleteQuestion
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a question by ID.
